title: New York attorneys: registration business-contact route
hypothesis: The NY Attorney Registrations route can produce a current New York professional and published office business-contact candidate, but neither a surname-in-firm signal nor the office phone proves ownership or a direct owner handset. The parser must itself reject non-NY rows rather than rely only on the source query.
ownerSource: NYS Attorney Registrations can establish a currently registered person and company-name context. A surname in a firm is a named-partner heuristic only; independent firm-owner evidence is required for owner confirmation.
phoneSource: The source's published phone is an office business-contact candidate. It is not evidence of a personal mobile or direct owner contact, even after generic phone verification.

workflow.label: NY attorney request
workflow.detail: Resolve the attorney_ny route; the Maps fallback and Maps delivery are forbidden.

workflow.label: NY Attorney Registrations
workflow.detail: Read the catalog-verified eqw2-r5nb professional registration source using its current-status and NY query.

workflow.label: Current person parse
workflow.detail: The implemented parser requires Currently registered status and a person name; it currently relies on the query, rather than the parser, for NY state scope.

workflow.label: Registration hold
workflow.detail: Hold inactive, non-person, unavailable-source, and, after the proposed correction, non-NY rows.

workflow.label: NY state guard
workflow.detail: Proposed fail-closed parser guard: retain only rows whose normalized state is NY.

workflow.label: Published office business-contact candidate
workflow.detail: Keep the professional registration, company context, and published office phone as business-contact evidence only. Surname-in-firm remains a heuristic.

workflow.label: Reuse and switchboard check
workflow.detail: Hold high-reuse or switchboard contacts; uniqueness does not prove an owner handset.

workflow.label: Shared-contact hold
workflow.detail: Hold shared office or switchboard patterns before direct-contact classification.

workflow.label: Line and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Apply mobile, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone controls.

workflow.label: Contact gate hold
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, stale, or timezone-unresolved contacts.

workflow.label: Independent owner and direct-contact evidence
workflow.detail: A future owner-labelled result needs supported owner/founder evidence for the firm and an explicit direct business-contact link to this phone.

workflow.label: Owner claim unresolved
workflow.detail: Hold employee, associate, front-desk, heuristic-only, conflicting, or unlinked evidence.

workflow.label: Future owner-confirmed delivery
workflow.detail: Deliver only after contact/compliance gates and independent owner/direct-contact evidence pass.

failures.risk: A current non-NY registration reaches the NY workflow through a cache, malformed query, or direct parser caller.
failures.mitigation: Add a fail-closed normalized NY state check inside nyAttorneyRow and hold other states.

failures.risk: Surname-in-firm is treated as owner or named-partner confirmation.
failures.mitigation: Keep it as a heuristic only and require independent firm-owner evidence before any owner label.

failures.risk: The published office phone is labelled a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Keep it as a business-contact candidate and require separate reuse, line, compliance, and direct-business-contact evidence.

failures.risk: A register outage or non-NY request falls back to Maps delivery.
failures.mitigation: Keep attorney_ny in NEVER_MAPS_DELIVERABLE so the quote remains blocked without its eligible register route.

iterations.hypothesis: The NY parser fails closed for source scope as well as current-status and person requirements.
iterations.test: Five-case synthetic local audit on 2026-09-24 directly through nyAttorneyRow: current NY, current non-NY, delinquent, missing-name, and no-firm variants; plus node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern='ny_attorneys' tests/lead-engine-registers.test.ts. No network, provider, secret, paid call, or private-contact lookup ran.
iterations.observed: The focused test passed. Current NY, current non-NY, and no-firm variants were kept; Delinquent was held as status_not_registered and missing-name as not_a_person. The current non-NY result exposes the absent parser state guard. This is parser behavior only, not ownership, contact quality, compliance, or delivery evidence.
iterations.change: Propose a normalized NY state check in nyAttorneyRow and a synthetic non-NY-current regression fixture; retain all accepted phones as office business-contact candidates until independent owner/direct-contact evidence exists.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: The NY attorney parser now enforces state=NY itself and holds non-NY or missing-address-state rows, matching the declared adapter query scope. The never-Maps guard and ownership-unconfirmed export wording also apply.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five synthetic parser cases: two intended NY/current or solo candidates kept, one current non-NY case incorrectly kept, one delinquent case held, and one missing-person case held. The focused ny_attorneys fixture test passed. Fixture/code audit only; no live source, phone, owner, handset, compliance, or delivery measurement.

cost.basis: Local five-case fixture/code audit only; no source fetch, provider, append, trace, review, or phone-verification call ran.
cost.note: No clean owner contact was measured. Catalog availability and historical brain estimates use different denominators and do not establish clean-contact cost.

implementation.summary: The NY attorney parser now enforces state=NY itself and holds non-NY or missing-address-state rows, matching the declared adapter query scope. The never-Maps guard and ownership-unconfirmed export wording also apply. Original review: The NY register adapter, current-status/person parsing, published office-phone candidate route, and attorney_ny never-Maps guard are implemented. The parser does not independently enforce NY state scope, and the delivery path lacks a wired owner/direct-contact evidence requirement; therefore no owner-confirmed attorney outcome is implemented.

nextMeasurement: After the parser state guard and owner/direct-contact gate are wired, run a lawful 5–20-row aggregate study only from the catalog-verified NY public registration endpoint. Separate current NY registration, person, firm/solo candidate, unique published business-phone, independently owner-supported, mobile, reachable, DNC/TCPA-clear, suppression/duplicate-clear, direct-business-contact-supported, and delivered denominators. Do not use residential/property data to discover private numbers; perCleanUsd remains null until an approved outcome study.
